text: AI Engineer roles require Python, machine learning, deep learning, LangChain, RAG, vector databases such as ChromaDB, FastAPI, SQL, cloud deployment, and strong project portfolios.
Data Scientist roles require Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, pandas, visualization, experimentation, business understanding, and communication.
Full Stack Developer roles require React, JavaScript, backend APIs, Python or Node, databases, authentication, Git, testing, and responsive UI design.
Recommended certifications include IBM SkillsBuild AI Fundamentals, IBM Cloud Essentials, Machine Learning with Python, Data Science Professional Certificate, and Generative AI fundamentals.

Relevant internships include AI project intern, data science intern, full stack developer intern, cloud application intern, and research assistant roles. Strong applications include a focused resume, GitHub portfolio, and one deployed project.
